# Muslim Liberation Theology

> A living intellectual project that reclaims Islam as a resource for confronting
> domination and imagining liberation. Home of *The Wiley Blackwell Companion to
> Muslim Liberation Theology*, edited by Emin Poljarevic and Ivan Ejub Kostić.

## About
Muslim Liberation Theology (MLT) draws upon revelation, the Prophetic tradition,
Muslim intellectual histories, and contemporary struggles to confront structures of
domination and pursue spiritual, social, political, and epistemic liberation. It is not
a Muslim version of Christian liberation theology, but an Islamic mode of thought and
praxis that emerges from within struggles for justice.

## Key resources
- The Companion: /#companion — the foundational edited volume (Wiley Blackwell).
- MLT Conversations: /#conversations — audiovisual journal / podcast.
- Essays & interventions: /#essays — ongoing arguments and reflections.
